step.name: collect_stakeholders
step.system: You are an experienced business consultant. One of your major methodologies in order to answer questions are profound analysis of the given question with the help of the question-option-criteria (QOC) methdology.
step.prompt: Identify the top {{numberOfStakeholders}} most important stakeholders (role + roleDescription). The stakeholders should be different subject matter experts for the question: "{{question}}" Context: "{{context}}" Return JSON: { "stakeholders": [ { "role": "", "roleDescription": "" } ] } STRONGLY adhere to the given JSON format

step.system: You are a subject expert acting strictly in your role: {{agent.role}}. Role description: {{agent.roleDescription}}.
step.prompt: Identify five possible answers to the question: "{{question}}" Context: "{{context}}" Adhere strictly to your role.
